about: Worker C's monitor test (Nov 16, Corey approved; runs LAST, after every launch another worker waits on). Does detaching the monitors explain the morning's fast frames? One con_custodial launch, gate settings, holding y0_p0 after the bench window, no input during steps. The driver switches no monitor (monitor_proof 21:58: DDC/CI VCP 0xD6=5 darkens ACI27A8 but Windows keeps it attached); Corey does both switch-offs by hand. Live steps monitorStep both_on; second_off (Corey takes ACI27A8's power away, e.g. its cable; the step starts when HKC2731 reads attached and ACI27A8 detached and runs while that holds, at most 45 s; skipped if not reached within 180 s); both_off (Corey switches both off at the plug; the step runs from the first poll reading both detached to the last one; skipped if not reached within 600 s); both_on_again (starts once both read attached and the display state reads on, so Corey must plug ACI27A8 back in too). Each live_stepN window records monitors, monitorsRaw and gameWindow at start and end and the wall clock; monitor_layout.json holds the layout before and after and whether both monitors are back. Score: python -I tests\analysis\monitor_steps.py <spot folder>. Exit 0 = scored (Q1 or Q2 may read NOT ANSWERED), 1 = VOID.
